title: Jangle Pop
tagline: Bright, chiming guitars and melodic songs with a light, ringing sound.
summary: Jangle pop is built around bright, ringing electric guitars and melodic songwriting. Its sound draws on 1960s pop and folk-rock, often pairing chiming guitar tones with concise arrangements and reflective lyrics. The style has appeared across independent scenes in different countries and generations.

pillars.name: The Byrds
pillars.why: The Byrds' chiming twelve-string guitar sound became a key influence on later jangle-pop bands.

pillars.name: R.E.M.
pillars.why: R.E.M. brought jangling guitars and literate songwriting into a distinctive American college-rock sound.

pillars.name: The Smiths
pillars.why: Johnny Marr's bright, melodic guitar work helped make the Smiths a major reference for jangle pop.
